name: STA261H1 — Deductive Derivation (Likelihood Ratio Tests)
description: LRT: H₀:θ∈Θ₀ vs H₁:θ∈Θ₁. Λ(x)=sup_{Θ₀}L(θ)/sup_{Θ}L(θ). Reject when Λ<c (H₀ much less likely). Generalization of Neyman-Pearson to COMPOSITE hypothese

steps.template_en: LRT: H₀:θ∈Θ₀ vs H₁:θ∈Θ₁. Λ(x)=sup_{Θ₀}L(θ)/sup_{Θ}L(θ). Reject when Λ<c (H₀ much less likely). Generalization of Neyman-Pearson to COMPOSITE hypotheses.
steps.template_zh: LRT: Λ(x)=sup_{Θ₀}L(θ)/sup_{Θ}L(θ)。Λ小时拒绝。Neyman-Pearson到复合假设的推广。

steps.template_en: N(μ,σ²), both unknown. H₀:μ=μ₀. Λ=(σ̂₀²/σ̂²)^{-n/2}. Reject when Λ small ⟺ [Σ(xᵢ-μ₀)²/Σ(xᵢ-x̄)²] large ⟺ |t| large (t test!).
Wilks' Theorem: under H₀, -2logΛ→χ²_{dim(Θ)-dim(Θ₀)} in distribution. WHY we compute asymptotic p-values without exact sampling distribution! Critical values from χ² table.
steps.template_zh: Wilks定理：-2logΛ→χ²分布。这就是为什么可以计算渐近p值而无需精确抽样分布！

steps.template_en: Logistic regression: H₀: β₁=β₂=0. Full: β₀+β₁x₁+β₂x₂. Reduced: β₀ only. Λ=L(reduced)/L(full). -2logΛ>χ²_{2,0.05} → reject. The 'deviance test' in GLM.
steps.template_zh: 逻辑回归：H₀:β₁=β₂=0。全模型vs简化。-2logΛ>χ²_{2,0.05}→拒绝。GLM中的'偏差检验'。

steps.template_en: LRTs WIDELY applicable: t, F, χ², deviance tests — ALL special cases. ASYMPTOTICALLY optimal. Cost: χ² approx poor for small n. Use exact (t, F) when available.
steps.template_zh: LRT广泛适用：t、F、χ²、偏差检验——都是特例。渐近最优。代价：小n时χ²近似不佳。

steps.template_en: LRT reveals UNIFYING principle: compare MAXIMIZED likelihoods. Extends to: (1) AIC/BIC (penalized log-likelihood). (2) Score tests. (3) Wald tests. The 'Holy Trinity' of testing.
steps.template_zh: LRT揭示统一原理：比较最大化似然。扩展到AIC/BIC、Score检验、Wald检验。检验的'神圣三一'。
